fit_reason: Whole pickup truck listed by a private seller on Marketplace.
findings: Hazy, yellowed driver-side headlight lens on the front
Dull, flat-looking white paint on the hood and front fenders
Grey interior with general dust on the dash, door panels and center console
Scuffed leather on the driver seat bolster and cushion with a small mark on the edge
Grime and rust staining inside the bed on the side walls and bed mat
Light scuffs on the lower rear quarter panel near the bumper on the driver side
message: Hola, vimos su anuncio de la F-150. Los faros delanteros se ven opacos y amarillentos, y la pintura blanca del cofre se ve un poco apagada, cosas que una restauración de faros y un pulido mejoran mucho en las fotos. Hacemos detallado completo antes de vender y vamos a su casa. ¿Le gustaría una cotización? / Hi, we saw your F-150 listing. The headlights look hazy and the white paint on the hood looks a bit dull, which a headlight restoration and buff would freshen up for buyers. We do pre-sale details and come to you, would you like a quote?
